term: actuality of the potential as such (entelecheia tou dynamei ontos hei toiouton)
definition: `ActualizedQuaPotential x r`: x's potency for r, precisely as a potency, is being actualized, as the buildable is being built while it is buildable. A primitive of the Physics III.1 analysis of being moved; it does not decide between actuality and actualization and adds no time, mover or completion.
